title: The Seed Vault
text: The planet below is an archive — the last deliberate act of a civilization that had already lost. Everything it knew was buried here and left for someone. You are not that someone. You are what answered the alarm.

title: The Sentinel
text: A pre-collapse science vessel, recovered and only partly understood. Its original crew is centuries dead. Researching its Protocols is not an upgrade path — it is the slow recovery of a machine that used to know how to defend itself.

title: The Harvest
text: Not aliens. Self-replicating extraction machines built by the same lost civilization, still executing a resource order no one remembers issuing. They are not cruel. They are just very, very thorough.

title: Skiff
text: The smallest Harvest unit, produced in bulk from raw feedstock. Individually trivial. The danger is arithmetic: a hundred of them arriving at once from every bearing.

title: Hauler
text: A mobile ore bucket with its face armored against rockfall. Chip damage barely scratches it. Bring something that punches once, hard.

title: Interceptor
text: A courier frame stripped for speed. It jinks constantly and slow ordnance simply misses. Hitscan weapons and the hero's guns do not care how fast it is.

title: Aegis Cruiser
text: Escort hull with a regenerating deflector envelope. Damage that doesn't break the shield in one sustained push is damage wasted — the envelope heals in seconds.

title: Bombard
text: A siege platform that halts beyond your turret arcs and lobs shells inward. It will never close the distance. You have to reach it, intercept the shells, or drive it off with the ship.

title: Carrier
text: A slow foundry that assembles Skiffs mid-approach and releases them continuously. Kill the Carrier and the tide stops at the source. Ignore it and you are fighting two problems.

title: Phase Runner
text: Short-range translation drive, cycled every few seconds. It is untargetable mid-jump and it does not acknowledge obstacles. Saturation fire and a snare on the landing zone are the answers.

title: Leech
text: A boarding parasite. It clamps onto a turret and shorts it out for ten seconds, then dies. A defense resting on one perfect turret has a ten-second hole in it now.

title: Warden
text: Carries no weapon. It projects a maintenance field that heals and re-shields every Harvest unit around it. Killing front-to-back means killing nothing. Kill the Warden.

title: Siege Crawler
text: Overbuilt, overheavy, and fitted with inertial dampers that shrug off every tractor and time field you own. There is no clever answer. There is only enough damage.

title: The Threshing Gate
text: Not a unit. A structure that walked. It periodically folds into an armored shell — only the seam stays vulnerable — then unfolds to advance. Whatever it was built to process, it was not built to be stopped.
